scope: Independent source inspection, AST/diff and SHA256 binding audit; consume corrected no-ODE qualification receipt without rerunning its numerical tests.

static_findings.geometry_expressions: Same leggauss, compactification, FD factor, radial multiplication order and angular numerator as frozen constructor.
static_findings.amplitude_order: W=1+A*(3*mu*mu-1)/2; division remains after A multiplication. No cached divided P2 shortcut.
static_findings.backing: Factory arrays and per-case distributions are NumPy views over immutable Python bytes; write=True is not available through the ordinary ndarray API.
static_findings.metadata_guards: Factory checks configuration plus array identity/dtype/shape/strides/writeable signatures before make and identity; mapping is read-only and dataclass is frozen.
static_findings.case_isolation: Geometry buffers are shared; each case receives its own ndarray views and fresh immutable packet/cell byte buffers. Future A trials do not replace an earlier case distribution.
static_findings.source_closure: IndependentStressBuilder calls parent.verify_source before template/factory construction; all 9 frozen vendor files independently match manifest.
static_findings.RHS_integrator: No new RHS or integrator implementation; source inheritance retained. solve_case AST unchanged, n=101, rtol=3e-11, atol=3e-13, FP64 40-state output.
static_findings.normalization: component_fields AST unchanged, full Frobenius signed coordinates retained; pressure SI coupling uses 8*pi*G/c^2 with proper-time H, equivalent to kappa_E with H/c.
static_findings.discrete_model: Same LRS collisionless PR147 model, fixed fm=0.1, m/T=30, 24x12 Gauss3 momentum cells, L=8, common gamma/nu initial k.

accepted_qualification.mapping_comparison: 125 Python dictionary-equality checks (not a byte-level claim for every receipt value); 125 initial-state arrays compared as FP64 bytes.
accepted_qualification.constructor_comparison: 15 constructor configurations: arrays shape/dtype/bytes, normalization/number FP64 bytes; 45 moment states FP64 bytes.
accepted_qualification.saved_state_comparison: 375 points: indices 0,50,100 of each of 125 existing histories; 22125 numeric field values and 15000 RHS values compared as FP64 bytes.
accepted_qualification.cases: 26 original C21M + 98 returned NCP + 1 reused C21L center, 125 unique target tuples independently counted.
accepted_qualification.original_comparator: Frozen C21M builder optimized=False uses original CanonicalMomentumFV constructor and moment method.
accepted_qualification.integrator_forbidden: Test replaces CanonicalFVSpecies.integrate with a raising sentinel while evaluating the 125 cases.
accepted_qualification.immutable_and_domain_checks: Receipt/source show immutable buffers, shared geometry with separate distributions, frozen configuration, shape mutation rejection, invalid domain rejection, and five A trials with leggauss replaced by a raising sentinel.

preserved_failure.cause: Harness expected manifest grid at the wrong nesting and raised KeyError(contract) before the actual125 loop.
preserved_failure.fix: Only manifest[manifest][grid][cases] lookup changed; current test bytes equal old test bytes after this single text substitution.
preserved_failure.first_three_groups: Three other groups passed in v1; v2 all four groups passed.

external_method_attribution.reused: Immutable bytes-backed arrays and explicit metadata/kernel identity guard principle.
external_method_attribution.not_transferred: C15 physical source, exact (x,b) LRU result cache, its integration results, and performance claims.
external_method_attribution.local_extension: A-independent original-PR147 constructor preparation; every A-dependent physical population and normalization is rebuilt.

limits: No new ODE solves or whole-trajectory byte-equivalence run with the C21N builder; qualification is constructor, IC and sampled fields/RHS only.
No universal bitwise theorem for every allowed mass/grid/A/platform; empirical comparison scope is the listed 15 configurations and 125 existing target cases.
No measured speedup, memory reduction or 64-core scaling claim.
Factory guards protect prepared inputs at construction/identity boundaries, not hostile Python reflection or arbitrary mutation of returned original model objects.
The standalone factory does not itself reverify the vendor closure; the reviewed production entry is IndependentStressBuilder, which does.
General triaxial dynamics, native reionization/UV/stars coupling and complete CMB prediction remain outside this review.
